title: From random walks to Brownian risk factors
objectives: Distinguish a process law from its one-time distributions and identify a sufficient Markov state
Derive the square-root time scaling of a finite random walk and its limiting Gaussian endpoint
Specify Brownian motion through its increments and path regularity
Derive a diffusion equation as a continuum consistency limit without claiming an unproved path-convergence theorem
prerequisites: Probability, conditional probability, means and variances, and elementary Taylor expansion. Chapter 1's distinction between payoff scenarios and probability assignments.
source_scope: Full sequential reading of official English captions for playlist positions 37–39. Formal definitions, examples, convergence qualifications, and numerical certificates are original expansions; no comprehensive audiovisual audit.
